content.text: Applies to select flights marked with the Black Friday label
Applies to select destinations in Canada, Mexico, the US, Africa, Asia, Europe, and South America.

Black Friday Deal amount is paid by Booking.com on your behalf. Prices may change during the campaign period. Booking.com reserves the right to stop the Black Friday Deal promotion earlier if the total financial value of the promotional offers already redeemed exceeds a certain financial value.
